title: Content/widget results-matrix row
description: One row per built-in content type (US1, #6239) or per widget (US2 static shell, #6240) or per DTS service (US3 interaction, #6241) or per forms confirmation case set (US3 forms matrix, #6482) or per membership registration case set (US3 membership matrix, #6559 / parent #6241, proved #6484) or per comments moderation case set (US3 moderation matrix, #6485) or per polls vote case set (US3 polls matrix, #6241) or per feeds entries case set (US3 feeds matrix, #6560 / parent #6241) or per metadata index-search case set (US3 metadata matrix, #6560 / parent #6241). Rows are built by tests/helpers/content-create-matrix.js buildResultRow (US1), tests/helpers/published-widget-matrix.js buildWidgetRow (US2), tests/helpers/dts-interaction-matrix.js buildInteractionRow (US3), tests/helpers/forms-confirmation-matrix.js buildConfirmationRow (US3 forms), tests/helpers/membership-registration-matrix.js buildRegistrationRow (US3 membership), tests/helpers/comments-moderation-matrix.js buildModerationRow (US3 moderation), or tests/helpers/polls-vote-matrix.js buildVoteRow (US3 polls), tests/helpers/feeds-entries-matrix.js buildEntriesRow (US3 feeds), or tests/helpers/metadata-index-matrix.js buildIndexRow (US3 metadata) and validated by the matching validate function; the Playwright inventory/matrix specs fail when a row does not conform.

suite.description: Matrix suite that produced the row.

spec.description: Spec file that produced the row, module-relative (e.g. tests/content-create-matrix.spec.js).

contentType.description: Built-in content-type name as listed by GET /services/contenttypes (US1), pinned widget name for the US2 static matrix (simple* covers the legacy simple list widgets), or pinned DTS service name for the US3 interaction matrix (polls, feeds, forms, comments, metadata, membership).

label.description: Catalog label for the content type, or display label for the widget.

cell.description: QA cell the row was produced on. US1 runs on the CMS-only cell (no DTS dependency); US2 runs against the published site (needs the DTS publish path, PUBLISHED_SITE_URL); US3 runs against the DTS-providing cell (DTS_BASE_URL).

createRoundTrip.description: Create via the editor New-item flow, then save and reopen with values round-tripped.

negativeRequired.description: Blank required field shows a visible message and persists nothing.

staticRender.description: Widget static output renders on its published fixture page with zero missing resources.

interact.description: DTS service round-trip succeeds (vote persists, feed renders, form confirms, comment follows moderation, index reflects content, login round-trips).

submitConfirm.description: Forms confirmation matrix (#6482): self-seeded form submit takes the success redirect (HTTP 302 to /success.html).

summariesRetrievable.description: Forms confirmation matrix (#6482): the admin summaries for the probe form report exactly one more submission after the probe submit.

csvRetrievable.description: Forms confirmation matrix (#6482): the admin CSV export for the probe form contains the submitted probe entry.

registerCreates.description: Membership registration matrix (#6559): a self-seeded probe account registers (POST /membership/user) with SUCCESS and an issued session id.

loginRoundTrip.description: Membership registration matrix (#6559): the freshly registered credentials log in (POST /membership/login) and resolve through the session lookup (POST /membership/session).

logoutCloses.description: Membership registration matrix (#6559): logout (POST /membership/logout) succeeds and the session lookup no longer resolves the account.

rejectHides.description: Comments moderation matrix (#6485): the gated reject surface (PUT /comment/moderation/reject) removes the probe from the public list.

voteCreates.description: Polls vote matrix (#6241): a self-seeded probe poll is created by voting (POST /polls/save) with SUCCESS and totalVotes >= 1.

votePersists.description: Polls vote matrix (#6241): a second vote for the same probe question increments totalVotes by exactly one on re-read (GET /polls/{pollName}).

resultsByQuestion.description: Polls vote matrix (#6241): the question read (GET /polls/question/{pollQuestion}) answers SUCCESS with the same totals and voted choice as the named read.

descriptorCreates.description: Feeds entries matrix (#6560): a self-seeded probe descriptor is created (PUT /rss/descriptors) with 2xx for a fresh probe site.

entriesServe.description: Feeds entries matrix (#6560): the generated feed (GET /rss/{site}/{feed}/localhost) answers 200 text/xml carrying the probe descriptor title plus both seeded entries.

unseededRedirects.description: Feeds entries matrix (#6560): a feed URL for a name that was never seeded answers 302 to the feeds error page (the documented unseeded-name outcome).

indexQueryAnswers.description: Metadata index matrix (#6560): the index query (POST /metadata/get) answers 200 with a result list shape.

seededEntryRetrievable.description: Metadata index matrix (#6560): a self-seeded probe index row is contained in the re-queried results, then removed.

cleanupRemoves.description: Metadata index matrix (#6560): a seeded-then-removed probe row no longer appears in the re-queried results.

status.description: Row roll-up: fail wins over skip wins over pass.
